newsitem.title: INDONESIA: Sampoerna ups price of leading brand.
newsitem.headline: Sampoerna ups price of leading brand.

text.p: Indonesian cigarette maker PT Hanjaya Mandala Sampeorna said on Tuesday it had increased the retail (banderol) price of its main Dji Sam Soe brand to 1,800 rupiah from 1,700 rupiah per pack.
"We have just increased the price to 1,800 rupiah effective from yesterday (Monday)," director of corporate development Jonathan Zax told Reuters.
Dji Sam Soe, Sampoerna's premium brand, accounted for more than 50 percent of Sampoerna's 1996 sales value and was expected to maintain its position, Zax said without giving further details.
Analysts said Sampoerna was expected to further raise the retail price of Dji Sam Soe to at least 2,000 rupiah this year as room to increase its sales volume was seen limited.

"Raising the price is a logical choice as it would not be easy to boost Dji Sam Soe sales due to its rather specific target market," Laksono Widodo, an analyst with PT ING Barings Securities Indonesia, said.

Widodo said Sampoerna's audited results announced on Tuesday was not much different from its unaudited results previously announced, except for one-time gains coming from the sale of its stake in automobile conglomerate PT Astra International.
Sampoerna said on Tuesday it posted an audited consolidated net profit of 396.54 billion rupiah in 1996 against 352.21 billion rupiah in 1995.
Sampoerna announced in late February that it posted an unaudited net profit of 394 billion rupiah in 1996.
Sampoerna said profit from short-term investments was 22.11 billion rupiah. The amount was expected to include the sale of Sampoerna's stake in Astra, analysts said.
